summary: The note is a short encyclopedic entry on the 14.5×114mm cartridge, also designated .57 Cal. It describes the round as a heavy machine gun and anti-materiel rifle cartridge. The note states that it has been used by the Soviet Union, the former Warsaw Pact, modern Russia, and other countries.
one_line: The 14.5×114mm (.57 Cal) is a heavy machine gun and anti-materiel rifle cartridge used by the Soviet Union, the former Warsaw Pact, and modern Russia.
